_comment: Sample pip artifact manifest for uvicorn. ASGI server underlying every FastAPI runner. Touches the network on every request, so it's exactly the kind of dependency that benefits from a pinned hash.
name: uvicorn

metadata.note: Any pip package that opens a listening socket gets an elevated severity tag. Communities can use this to set a higher M-of-N threshold for `packages/python/install` actions involving elevated-severity packages.
